name: German Citizen Conference on the Future Energy Technologies
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The process included eight regional conferences with randomly selected citizens. In early November, all participants of the regional conferences (about 100 people in total) met for a final two-day meeting during which they drafted a report with policy recommendations. Influence, Outcomes, and Effects The final report was handed over to political authorities but its policy impact is unknown.
